blocks.text: Lucian Piane, a former “RuPaul’s Drag Race” music producer and guest judge, died after being hit in a road accident in California. He was 46. This was confirmed by a Los Angeles County Medical Examiner record obtained by PEOPLE, which indicated that the music producer died from blunt trauma and that his death was ruled an accident. Piane was reportedly struck by a vehicle while walking at an intersection, as per a Glendale Police Department spokesperson. “Firefighters and paramedics provided emergency medical care to an adult patient at the scene.
